name: Cheesecake

For the crust: Pinch of salt (may skip if the butter is unsalted)
For 1L small mold: Little amount of oil or butter

instructions: - Preheat oven to 165ºC, mix the broken biscuit crumbs with everything, then the flour, butter the mold, press the mix into the base and sides, then bake for 18'.
- Mix everything else, starting with eggs and sugar. When the crust is ready, take it out, lower temperature to 93ºC, pour in the mixture and bake for 3 hours.

culinary: Do not attempt to take it out of the mold before it's cold since it may crumble easily.
